summary: Start with a thesis path: core judgment, dimensions, evidence roles, counter-thesis, missing but retrievable gaps, and what would change the view.
agent_implication: Research Lead must supervise and revise the path after specialists return, not only dispatch tasks.

summary: Product specs, architecture, customer deployment, supply chain and channel availability can support bounded thesis drivers even without SKU revenue.
agent_implication: Memo must distinguish exact operating KPI from technical/adoption/performance signals, but cannot ignore non-financial strong signals.

summary: Financial statement analysis should cover income statement, balance sheet and cash flow, compare peers, and adapt metrics to industry economics.
agent_implication: Fundamental specialist must connect statement changes to product, industry and capital context instead of isolated ratio commentary.

summary: Equity flow, ownership, liquidity, valuation, options/futures, credit and corporate actions explain whether market pricing and capital access support or pressure fundamentals.
agent_implication: Market/capital specialists must separate fundamental value from market expectation, funding window, crowding and price-in degree.

summary: Customer capex, deployments, orders, supplier constraints and upstream capacity form read-through chains but require source authority and boundary labels.
agent_implication: Relationship graph should provide paths; model explains which paths matter and what cannot be inferred.

summary: Strong non-financial signals can affect expectations before official revenue disclosure, but must carry source strength, boundary and risk of non-realization.
agent_implication: Promotion gates must allow bounded thesis drivers instead of forcing all useful signals into exact financial fact standards.

summary: For AI/Semis cases, Research Lead should classify theme exposure/materiality, rate-of-change direction, company specificity and price-in boundary before dispatching specialists or writer material.
agent_implication: Research Lead must output thesis path and required-item answer plan, not only evidence requests.

summary: Official product architecture, specs, generation edges, deployment questions and competitive relationships can support bounded product capability judgment even without SKU revenue.
agent_implication: Product Specialist and MemoLogicPlan must separate technical/adoption evidence from product revenue, shipment or ASP exact claims.

summary: AI/Semis analysis must separate industry cycle, structural AI demand, value-chain position, bottleneck, export-control risk and company-specific exposure.
agent_implication: Industry/supply-chain specialist must not use peer group membership as primary proof; company-specific claims require issuer or company-bound rows.

summary: Memo output should be answer-first and thesis-led, using JudgmentCards, required-item answers, counter-thesis, catalysts, valuation/price-in context, risks, boundaries and typed gaps.
agent_implication: Writer receives writer-ready judgment material, not raw evidence dump; boundary language cannot dominate the core view.

summary: Investment memo/workpaper lifecycle should be append-only, reviewable, supersession-aware and able to feed post-decision learning.
agent_implication: Verifier and Workbench review surfaces must reference claims/artifacts and cannot mark unreviewed memo as accepted decision.

Local runtime owns all material values periods units signs scopes formulas identity and clauses. Optional narrative is an L3 shell rather than a truth owner or L1 completion requirement.

summary: DELL OEM analysis still requires exact issuer order revenue working-capital and cash-conversion authority; the method contracts now sit behind a bounded T06 entry readiness gate rather than a new H01 stage or another T05 run.
agent_implication: The model may select only request-local aliases and finite judgment enums; local runtime owns all material values and identity. This may be implemented once as a zero-call entry bundle and may not trigger iterative repair or DELL R12.

The model annotates only that pool; local runtime validates and selects final Facts. Keyword heuristics ticker branches Provider order and silent truncation are forbidden.

The Provider annotates only pool aliases; local code validates all candidates and selects final Facts. No keyword ticker embedding Provider-order or silent-truncation path is allowed.

summary: MU HBM typed coverage consumption remains runtime injected and current-fixture proven. An independent zero-call reproducibility proof is now authorized but not executed; no new financial output evidence exists.

summary: MU HBM typed coverage remains current-worktree runtime injected and fixture proven, but independent disposable-runtime reproducibility was not established because the first proof environment failed before parity and did not preserve complete diagnostics.

summary: The MU HBM method remains runtime injected and current-worktree fixture proven, while MU R2 is honestly blocked and T06 is closed. Functional compatibility moves to T07, hermetic proof to S5 and paid transfer reacceptance to FIN 0.2.
agent_implication: Do not run another MU exact-live in T06. Preserve the method and use it in T07 regression without product-passing claims; only FIN 0.2 may reattempt MU transfer acceptance after contract consolidation.
known_boundary: No independent hermetic proof or owner-accepted MU product exists.

summary: DELL, MU and NVDA now share a versioned material Numeric truth method that binds source facts, recalculates margins, free cash flow, average-inventory days and selected capex intensity, and represents unavailable case-specific facts as typed gaps instead of inferred numbers.
agent_implication: Downstream Claim and table construction may reference only admitted base facts, deterministic derived metrics or typed gaps from the compiled program. Models must not invent missing segment, product, profit, PVM or comparable-working-capital values.
known_boundary: S1-02 does not prove source exhaustion or final research quality. S1-03 must attempt official-source acquisition and parser fallback; S3 must prove actual Agent consumption and content quality.

summary: For objectives without an explicit historical period, select the latest issuer annual filing public on or before research as-of; then resolve declared product or segment gaps only through deterministic official-document extraction bound to the original gap, otherwise preserve an attempt-backed typed gap.
agent_implication: Models and renderers do not choose fiscal year, infer product-level numbers from consolidated totals, or turn route failure into source exhaustion. They may consume only the selected current facts, deterministic formulas, approved semantic evidence and explicit remaining gaps.
known_boundary: This method proves as-of selection and bounded official-source promotion, not relationship Graph, retrieval usefulness, research reasoning, report quality, product acceptance or release.

summary: Create a relationship edge only when a current official source explicitly names a registered counterparty and the complete statement, issuer, publication date, capture and parser lineage all bind. Otherwise retain a typed empty without claiming source exhaustion.
agent_implication: Models may use an approved edge as evidence that an explicitly stated relationship exists. They may not convert partnership, competition or deployment edges into revenue, profit, order size, financial-materiality or causal claims without separate Numeric and Evidence authority.
known_boundary: This method proves current authoritative relationship records, not retrieval recall, analytical use, financial impact, UI projection, product acceptance or release.

summary: Treat source binding and semantic usefulness as separate gates, then compile each research query from current governed semantic, Numeric and Graph authorities. A missing useful proposition becomes a typed gap; a nonempty stale lexical top-k never establishes current recall.
agent_implication: S2/S3 Agents may consume only the 26 current governed candidates and explicit gaps for these three cases. They may not use the legacy BM25 snapshot as current authority, turn a caution list or table of contents into evidence, erase source-diversity exceptions, or infer financial impact from Graph edges.
known_boundary: This method proves deterministic candidate availability and honest gaps for DELL, MU and NVDA. It does not prove Agent selection, reasoning, eight-dimension content quality, product usability, Human acceptance or release.

summary: The company-specific alias-only method now enters representative Specialist nodes, resolves governed selections into local Claims and feeds bounded case-level Lead synthesis without repository-environment drift.
agent_implication: A representative Specialist selects only local aliases/enums; local runtime resolves mechanism, Evidence, gap, WWC, identity and lineage. Lead receives only bounded Claims.
known_boundary: Node-level deterministic consumption does not establish natural-output quality, context economy, S3 synthesis or product acceptance.

summary: Low-level Agent view construction is hermetic unless the production Research Lead or operator explicitly enables repository Product Intelligence autoload.
agent_implication: The model-visible evidence surface may not acquire undeclared repository rows; any production merge requires an explicit Research Lead decision.
known_boundary: This method controls context provenance, not evidence ranking or model reasoning quality.

summary: Evaluate changed model behavior with one preregistered request per representative family, capture the full request and response before local validation, stop on the first hard failure, and convert only request-local alias and enum choices into local Claims.
agent_implication: DeepSeek may select bounded evidence, gap, mechanism and what-would-change aliases. Local runtime continues to own company identity, financial values, dates, IDs, lineage and final narrative; the three-family pass does not authorize free-form report generation.
known_boundary: The method demonstrates bounded Specialist contract adherence, not context economy, dynamic DecisionSurface, cross-Cell Lead synthesis, Writer/Verifier quality, human acceptance or release.

summary: Freeze hidden Gold evidence slots and hard search-quality thresholds, prove target-in-pool before ranking, keep Gold expected insights outside the planner, and stop reranker work when candidate generation cannot support the intended recall.
agent_implication: The Evidence Tool Planner may see case objectives, source authority policies, candidates and typed missing-role triggers, but never hidden expected insights or evidence IDs. Ranking cannot compensate for an unreachable source/evidence pool.
known_boundary: The method is not yet runtime-injected into a current source discovery planner. Exact URL overlap is conservative; semantic alternative-source equivalence remains unproven.

summary: Expose only case-local judgment semantics to the model while retaining IDs, digests, exact values and lineage in a deterministic local authority sidecar.
agent_implication: The model selects bounded aliases and enums; local runtime resolves identity, values, lineage and final materialization.
known_boundary: This closes bounded S2 context economy and one-node compact-contract behavior only. It does not prove dynamic planning, cross-cell synthesis, final research-content quality, product acceptance or release.

summary: Keep observation selection separate from the claim that an observation supports a thesis. A bounded model selects request-local evidence; deterministic local policy classifies each selection as observation support, thesis support, boundary-only or counterevidence.
agent_implication: A model may retain an observed financial fact while returning cannot-infer. In that state the observation is boundary-only, a typed gap is mandatory and thesis-support promotion is forbidden.
known_boundary: This method repairs epistemic representation and local authority. It does not prove natural adherence to the renamed schema or final research-content quality.

summary: When a request exposes zero typed-gap choices but the bounded selector returns cannot-infer, compile one deterministic request-bound local gap rather than forcing the model to invent one or rejecting an honest boundary.
agent_implication: The Provider never authors the default gap. Existing upstream gap options must still be explicitly selected; only a proven zero-option surface permits local attachment.
known_boundary: This method repairs a representational edge case and terminal auditability; it does not prove the remaining natural calls or final content quality.

summary: After an exact-once bounded selector run, materialize Claim, cross-Cell synthesis and Workpaper locally, then assess not only completion but role coverage, typed gaps, numeric/WWC yield and formal scoreability.
agent_implication: Nine valid outputs are insufficient for product acceptance. Observation, thesis, boundary and counterevidence coverage must be reported separately, and final-delivery/Verifier/L1/L2 bindings must exist before scoring.
known_boundary: The method exposes completion and quality gaps; it does not itself create a formal score, paired gain or qualified-human acceptance.

summary: Seal an all-natural Workpaper into a final delivery, independently verify financial identity/value/unit/date authority and evidence-lineage/epistemic boundaries, then create a digest-bound score context only when both L1 and L2 pass.
agent_implication: Weak thesis or counterevidence coverage remains a quality finding rather than being hidden as an L1/L2 failure. A candidate becomes scoreable only after truth and fidelity checks pass, but scoreability never means acceptance.
known_boundary: This method does not assign eight-dimensional scores, establish paired material gain or sign qualified-human acceptance.

summary: Compare the Agent delivery with a deterministic claim-only baseline built from the exact same input-head and all-natural Claim Cards. Give the baseline a distinct Run/Artifact identity and prohibit reuse of Agent cross-cell synthesis, executive thesis and eight-lens Workpaper.
agent_implication: Historical reports and fixture previews are invalid comparators when governed inputs differ. The paired surface may be compiled automatically, but scores, material-gain judgments and content acceptance remain reviewer authority.
known_boundary: The method makes incremental synthesis value reviewable; it does not itself establish formal case quality, paired gain, qualified-human acceptance or S3 product proof.

summary: Preserve a complete autonomous raw candidate even when it fails content quality, compile corrections into a separate non-leaking ledger, and delay supervisor model repair until every case's raw benchmark is measured under the same visible contract.
agent_implication: Local code may delete or downgrade unsupported precision but cannot write missing research. A supervisor may expose visible failure classes and case-local evidence references under a fresh corrected identity, never hidden Gold. Later raw cases cannot consume earlier corrections.
known_boundary: This proves the correction and contamination boundary, not a corrected DELL candidate, supervised model recovery, MU/NVDA raw quality, formal scoring or human acceptance.

summary: Compile natural numeric renderings from typed unit families rather than exact enum strings, classify conditional valuation references separately from asserted facts, and enforce source-scope accounting invariants across Specialist, Synthesis and Writer surfaces.
agent_implication: Approximate and lower-bound units remain usable in natural prose, while trailing P/E cannot become a single-quarter multiple, combined deposits/commitments cannot become cash or refundable prepayment, and average FCF margin cannot become marginal revenue sensitivity without an approved formula.
known_boundary: These deterministic invariants catch named accounting and valuation transformations; they do not replace qualified analyst review, prove every financial mechanism, or validate the external source truth of the frozen benchmark pack.

summary: Compile natural currency-scale equivalents from the same typed numeric authority so that large USD-billion values may be rendered exactly or with controlled rounding in trillions without becoming new financial facts.
agent_implication: A model may render 5359 USD_billion as 5.359T, 5.36T or 5.4T when the source authority supports that value; unrelated thresholds or values remain unbound and rejected.
known_boundary: This proves a deterministic unit-equivalence repair, not a completed NVDA raw chain, research-quality improvement, supervisor recoverability or product acceptance.

summary: Require explicit causal bridge wording before classifying cash-flow-to-earnings or valuation misuse, while independently validating Evidence, Gap, Unit and Section identifiers by their typed roles and complete case-pack coverage.
agent_implication: A conditional list containing separate cash-flow and P/E thresholds is not itself a causal bridge; placing Gap IDs in evidence_ids or omitting assigned Evidence remains a material citation-authority failure.
known_boundary: This improves evaluator attribution and correction routing; it does not repair the raw reports, prove supervisor recovery or establish product acceptance.

summary: Measure supervised recoverability with one frozen correction protocol applied to physically isolated cases. A typed SupervisorPlan may expose visible finding classes and case-local aliases, while hidden Gold, other-case outputs and new source facts remain unavailable; originating nodes repair their own research and downstream dependencies are recomputed under fresh identities.
agent_implication: A supervisor is a bounded correction planner, not a hidden-answer oracle or deterministic report writer. Autonomous raw quality and supervised recovery must be reported separately, and all three cases must pass per-case material gates before the campaign is called proven.
known_boundary: The method is documented and decision-selected only. It is not yet contract-translated, runtime-injected, fixture-proven, paid-artifact-proven or human-accepted.

summary: Compile visible finding classes into case-qualified, node-grouped correction requirements; let the Supervisor select only case-local aliases; rerun originating nodes and every downstream dependency under a fresh shared-ledger exact-once identity; freeze the complete candidate before any hidden scoring.
agent_implication: The planner cannot write research prose or new facts. Each repaired node remains responsible for its own analysis, deterministic code cannot invent research, and a failure receipt remains auditable without becoming a business artifact.
known_boundary: Runtime and fixture evidence do not prove natural SupervisorPlan compliance, corrected research quality, hidden-score improvement or human acceptance.

summary: Compile a case research objective into issuer, regulatory, customer-demand, supply-counterevidence and market-context source roles; expand official entities by industry relationship role, revise only typed missing roles, and evaluate hidden Gold only after capture-first candidate generation.
agent_implication: The search planner may discover official documents and related issuers without seeing benchmark answers. It cannot retry the same query, use a future or cross-case source, or let ranking compensate for a missing target in the candidate pool.
known_boundary: Fixture source observations are evaluator scaffolding, not live search evidence. Ranking quality, semantic-equivalent source sufficiency, downstream research synthesis and qualified-human report acceptance remain separate gates.
